summary: Automation built-in nodes: set (CEL values), code (sandboxed TS/JS with declared secrets, env.fetch and env.connections through a connector's CodeAccessor, compiled on save), http (guarded HTTPS with secret or connection auth, success expression, idempotent only for GET/HEAD or an idempotency header), start_automation and run_automation (another graph's enabled version through its manual trigger, cascade depth, cancelled with the parent), and the SDK action registry (actions.Contribute) with core.user.block/unblock, core.group.add_user/remove_user and crm.chat.send_message; graph map params ("*" paths), OutputKeys, StepContext and wait outcomes; engine NodeValidator, EffectWaitKeyer, WakeResolver and StartFromStep.
